name: keepr
description: Read, add and change the records you keep in keepr, from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to your keepr account through its API. Read your collections, add records from a sentence, a list or a spreadsheet, and propose changes to cards — each write is dry-run first and shown to you before anything is committed. No key needed: the first time, Claude opens keepr in your browser and you click Allow. Or paste an API key from keepr (My Profile → API keys); it is stored by Claude, never in a file.

api_key.title: keepr API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty and Claude connects through your browser instead — you click Allow on keepr's page. A key, if you set one, is used instead: create it in keepr under My Profile → API keys.

tools.name: keepr_collections
tools.description: Who this connection acts as, what it may do (read, write, change cards, delete), and every keepr collection it can reach: the access level in each, whether items can be written there, and whether its cards can be changed.

tools.name: keepr_schema
tools.description: What a keepr collection accepts: its cards (record types), each card's elements (fields) with the type and id of each (#k7f3q2xa, how keepr's stored filters name an element), which elements keepr fills in itself, and the tags its items can carry.

tools.name: keepr_get_items
tools.description: Reads items from a keepr collection: a page of them, a count, or specific items by id, each with its tags by name (private tags included).

tools.name: keepr_search
tools.description: Finds things by text across every keepr collection this connection can reach: collections, cards, items, and tags (tags by name, and items used as tags by title, with the id to apply them by).

tools.name: keepr_chart
tools.description: Asks keepr for totals, counts and averages over a collection's items, answered as a table: how much, how many, the average, earliest and latest, shares of yes, money per currency, measurements in one unit, by month or by category.

tools.name: keepr_history
tools.description: Who changed what, and when: an item's, a card's or a collection's history in keepr, newest first.

tools.name: keepr_ingest
tools.description: Adds items to a keepr collection, or updates them by external_id (mode: "upsert").

tools.name: keepr_update_item
tools.description: Changes elements on existing keepr items, and adds or takes off their tags.

tools.name: keepr_propose_card
tools.description: Previews a new card (record type), or a change to one existing card, without changing anything: `cards` proposes new cards, `change` edits to one card, exactly one of the two.

tools.name: keepr_apply_card
tools.description: Creates or changes the card(s) a keepr_propose_card proposal previewed, exactly as previewed.

tools.name: keepr_propose_setup
tools.description: Previews setting up a collection, without changing anything: new cards, layouts (tile, table, page, form), saved filters, quick adds, element sets, tags, automations, notifications, charts and dashboards.

tools.name: keepr_apply_setup
tools.description: Applies exactly what a keepr_propose_setup proposal previewed, all or nothing.

tools.name: keepr_automations
tools.description: A collection's automations (rules) and notifications.

tools.name: keepr_set_automation_state
tools.description: Pauses a collection's automation (rule) or notification, or turns one on, by id, exact name or a notification's key.

tools.name: keepr_attach_file
tools.description: Attaches files to a keepr item.

tools.name: keepr_request_upload
tools.description: Makes a link for the person to upload files to keepr themselves: photos and documents on their computer or phone, or anything larger than keepr_attach_file carries (about a megabyte).

tools.name: keepr_upload_status
tools.description: What has arrived for an upload request made with keepr_request_upload: how many of the expected files are attached, and which items are still waiting.

tools.name: keepr_attach_folder
tools.description: Attaches a whole folder of files (photos, receipts, scans, videos, up to 100 MB each) from this computer's disk to the keepr items they belong to; nothing passes through the conversation.

tools.name: keepr_attach_status
tools.description: Progress of a keepr_attach_folder upload: how many files are uploaded, skipped, failed and still waiting, and why each failure failed.

tools.name: keepr_connect
tools.description: Connects this keepr server to the person's keepr account: it opens keepr in their browser, where they sign in if needed and click Allow; nothing to copy or paste.

tools.name: keepr_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnects this keepr server from the account keepr_connect connected it to: the connection is revoked in keepr and forgotten on this computer.
